title: "Build-pin drift attestation -- blob-form re-anchor of the arm-recipe digest pins (2026-11-04)"
---

Attestation record of the build-pin-reseal tools lane (DEBT-BUILD-PIN-DRIFT,
adjudicated by controller ruling 2026-11-04, remedy (b): every recipe digest pin
is anchored to the git blob digest of its source file at a named commit -- the
shape the SS3 law already assumes for images). Per the controller hold ruling of
the same date ("zero writes to the worktree pending the re-seal ruling, no
exceptions") this record is banked out-of-tree; on GREEN landing it transcribes
verbatim to `vignettes/articles/devlog-2026-11-04-m7-build-pin-drift-attestation.qmd` with the
companion pointer line in `bench/m7/README.md`'s devlog list:

- `vignettes/articles/devlog-2026-11-04-m7-build-pin-drift-attestation.qmd` -- arm-recipe digest-pin drift attestation and blob-seal law

Every hex below was emitted by command (pin-table.json / git plumbing); no
digest was typed into any tool call. The reading test
(`bench/m7/tests/test_recipe_blob_pins.py`, group (AM), registered in
`tests/run_all.py`) re-measures every claim here against git and disk on every
suite run -- this file is the narrative, the gate is the authority.

## 1. The drift, measured

`bench/m7/adapters/m7_entry.py` -- the frozen arm launcher -- has exactly three commits in its
lineage; the recipe pin never followed the last two:

| commit | date + subject | launcher bytes (sha256 of the git blob) |
|---|---|---|
| `2949e8a7ca626229d800396a2b2b96a6fe8773d2` | 2026-10-08 feat(m7): competitor benchmark harness — design+TDD RED+GREEN (U-M7-02) (#8) | `7ce0c147ccb7f3c3cb5fddf8062335544823eabfb6ab5423eb23a94b480c14be` |
| `1673a7f6aa3451e4a8fac1918bf927e3d8130fc6` | 2026-10-19 feat(p2): redesigned kernel call sites -- batch bridge, worker farm, governance, parse fast path, sidecar accounting v2 (#31) | `8a9e7ef00d19bb4f39ab55b901478a450a7cfef1faee8619a140164df3b16192` |
| `54c58d70dfb5057f5089d21c5afffb46d4716118` | 2026-11-03 feat(m7): promote the signeR competitor row on the live-inspect witness | `5abcb21e86bc91d896bcdecba35bc3549c1855a5001b8731b05ab8df165ba010` |

The pin was sealed honestly at the file's origin (the constant equals the blob
at the origin commit -- asserted, computed, in the control unit
`test_control_the_origin_sealed_launcher_pin_is_rejected_today`, which derives
the pin text's own first rider from the RECIPE's history and the origin bytes
from the launcher's own git log). The stale constant sat unwatched for sixteen
days; the sanctioned stage-1 bake (layer 18/33) caught it. The suite could sit
green across the window because, before this lane, the recipe's digest pins had
no reading test anywhere: each literal existed in exactly one file -- the
recipe enforcing it.

## 2. What the lane shipped (committed)

Group (AM) `test_recipe_blob_pins`, registered in `tests/run_all.py` (docstring
group register + MODULES): every pin site is read against four byte authorities
-- its own seal-commit blob, the blob at HEAD, the on-disk FLAT_INPUTS bytes
that ride the build context, and the file's last-touch lineage head -- plus the
completeness law (no FLAT_INPUTS COPY rides unpinned), the backing law (no
64-hex literal without a sealed site), a tamper roster whose defects derive
from measured values, the dead-pin control above, and the launcher's attested
three-move lineage pinned by value (a fourth silent move reddens the suite).
TDD face: single RED commit; module run 10/11 with exactly the one intended red
whose payload prints the byte-true capture (pin `7ce0c147...` vs disk bytes
`5abcb21e...` -- full values in the banked files); full suite 394/395 with that
one intended red. Evidence:
`red-module-20261104T035731Z.txt`, `red-module-final-20261104T040239Z.txt`,
`suite-redcommit-20261104T035813Z.txt`, `baseline-suite-main.txt` (384/384).

## 4. Batch-face lane note (controller ruling 2026-11-04, law verbatim)

> The two fork pins (run_sigminer_arm_batch.R 3cb83336..., self_witness_batch_arm.sh
> 95bde922...) live on the r1-batch-arm face, not on main. They must NOT enter this
> lane's main-based law: the reading test's required-pinned-input set must derive from
> the branch-face p6_build_arms.FLAT_INPUTS, not from hard-coded batch-face names. When
> the batch face later lands on main (via its own PR), the reading test automatically
> requires those two pins to be blob-backed against their files -- your module must
> already handle them, verified by that merge's CI. All your batch-face identification
> work must target `git show r1-batch-arm:<path>` blobs, never that branch's worktree
> files, which your lane never reads.

All three conditions hold: the module carries zero batch-face file names; its
completeness law is derived data-side from the branch-face
`p6_build_arms.FLAT_INPUTS`; every batch-face byte was read via `git show
r1-batch-arm:<path>` plumbing only -- zero reads, writes, builds or tests
against that worktree. The three batch-face constants, identified from blobs:

| batch-face constant | owner (identified by blob-digest match at the r1-batch-arm head) |
|---|---|
| `7ce0c147ccb7f3c3cb5fddf8062335544823eabfb6ab5423eb23a94b480c14be` | `m7_entry.py` |
| `3cb83336eb4acb2fa16283b509d62ad49f633d3bcd34fa8ef9b8f495193d00f4` | `run_sigminer_arm_batch.R` |
| `95bde92228e54bf668ce48a472c5057ee34a7abbb137b3a68b3fb34d68ce076d` | `self_witness_batch_arm.sh` |

- `7ce0c147ccb7f3c3cb5fddf8062335544823eabfb6ab5423eb23a94b480c14be` is the blob digest of `bench/m7/adapters/m7_entry.py` at `3ecd7e7c8fbe41fdd04b98ec61bf33ab555808fd` (identified via `git show r1-batch-arm:` plumbing only; the batch face still speaks the stale launcher bytes; blob-backing via the reading test is due before the batch-face merge))
- `3cb83336eb4acb2fa16283b509d62ad49f633d3bcd34fa8ef9b8f495193d00f4` is the blob digest of `bench/m7/adapters/run_sigminer_arm_batch.R` at `3ecd7e7c8fbe41fdd04b98ec61bf33ab555808fd` (identified via `git show r1-batch-arm:` plumbing only)
- `95bde92228e54bf668ce48a472c5057ee34a7abbb137b3a68b3fb34d68ce076d` is the blob digest of `bench/m7/adapters/self_witness_batch_arm.sh` at `3ecd7e7c8fbe41fdd04b98ec61bf33ab555808fd` (identified via `git show r1-batch-arm:` plumbing only)

The batch-face recipe still speaks the pre-drift launcher constant -- at the
batch-face merge, the (AM) gate redds until that site is blob-backed with the
same ceremony; the merge's change set is the prepared generator, executed by the
merge lane, never by this lane. The merge PR (separate owner, post-merge,
post-bake) carries that re-anchor; this lane prepared it and executed none of it.

- Zero pushes, zero PRs; branch `tools/build-pin-reseal` (unpushed, one commit on

- Isolated worktree
  (main-based); the shared worktree was never written by this lane.
- Recipe immutability proof while under hold: `git hash-object` of

  (`b57788c7...`) before and after every report-only run; `git diff --quiet HEAD`

- CJK gate (house tool, decoded scanner): `cjk_gate.sh --selftest` fired on the

- Zero typed digests: constants reach this record only via the computed
